[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Marina Mantis''' was the owner and [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of the [[Mantis Syndicate]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] during at least [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref> to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]].<ref name="GG9">''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]''</ref>

Bounty hunters hired personally by Lady Marina for the Syndicate were exempt from the usual selection process and from paying an annual fee to the Syndicate.<ref name="GG10" />

During the times of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the Syndicate worked mostly for [[High Lord]] [[Jaris Affric]] and his interests in the [[Sarin sector/Legends|Sarin sector]].<ref name="GG10" /> However, after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Affric was short on liquid assets and Lady Marina decided to withdrew the services of the Syndicate &mdash; much to his chagrin. To obtain profit, Lady Marina agreed to reduce her fees and work for anyone, still based mostly in the Sarin sector. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] occasionally hired the Syndicate, even if they considered Lady Marina to be highly amoral.<ref name="SM">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}} republished as {{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/source20090511b.html?page=1|text=Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>
